definitions.explanation: To become wider or cover more area.

examples.japanese: {目|め}の{前|まえ}に{青|あお}い{海|うみ}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: A blue ocean stretches out before my eyes.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}を{開|あ}けると、{美|うつく}しい{山|やま}の{景色|けしき}が{一面|いちめん}に{広|ひろ}がっていた。
examples.english: When I opened the window, a beautiful mountain landscape spread out as far as I could see.

examples.japanese: {可能性|かのうせい}が{広|ひろ}がる。
{新|あたら}しい{趣味|しゅみ}を{始|はじ}めて{友達|ともだち}の{輪|わ}が{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: I started a new hobby and my circle of friends expanded.

examples.japanese: インターネットの{普及|ふきゅう}で{情報|じょうほう}が{世界中|せかいじゅう}に{広|ひろ}がるようになった。
examples.english: With the spread of the internet, information has come to spread throughout the world.

notes:
{広|ひろ}がる is an intransitive verb meaning to spread, extend, or expand.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {広|ひろ}げる (transitive, to spread something)

ASPECT (ている):
{広|ひろ}がっている describes a state of being spread out or extended: {平野|へいや}が{広|ひろ}がっている (the plain extends/stretches out).

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- {噂|うわさ}が{広|ひろ}がる: rumors spread
- {火|ひ}が{広|ひろ}がる: fire spreads
- {被害|ひがい}が{広|ひろ}がる: damage spreads
- {景色|けしき}が{広|ひろ}がる: scenery stretches out
- {可能性|かのうせい}が{広|ひろ}がる: possibilities expand

PATTERNS:
- 〜に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread to ~
- 〜まで{広|ひろ}がる: to spread as far as ~
